RegistrationInfo.Description: Runs Trader AI's Phase 5 paper-trading entry pipeline (STEP0 crash-recovery heal, scan, gate, sizer, submit) once daily, shortly after NYSE open (D-05: no daemon mode). StartBoundary below (01:45 NZ local time) is the NZ-local-time equivalent of ~09:45 US Eastern computed for NZST (UTC+12) vs EDT (UTC-4), a 16-hour offset -- DST shifts this by an hour twice a year in each hemisphere (NZ's DST calendar and the US's DST calendar do not flip on the same dates), so the true NZ-local equivalent drifts across the year. This trigger is only the wake-up call: the code's own trader.paper.calendar_.is_trading_day/session_window check (inside run_entry_pipeline_once) is the real gate on whether today is an NYSE trading day, never this XML's StartBoundary alone. Registration deferred to the 05-09 human checkpoint.
